@deskSendEpicboxSwitched.description: Toast after the user switched the Epicbox server from the "server not answering" notice. {domain} is the new server's host name.

@deskSendEpicboxNotSwitched.description: Toast title when switching the Epicbox server failed; the reason follows as the toast text.

@deskSendEpicboxDownTitle.description: Title of the warning notice on Send and Receive when the Epicbox server does not answer.

deskSendEpicboxDownWait: Payments wait until it is back.

@deskSendEpicboxDownWait.description: Text of that notice when no other server is available.

@deskSendEpicboxSwitchTo.description: Text of that notice when another server is healthy. {domain} is its host name.

@deskSendEpicboxSwitch.description: Button in that notice: switch to the other server. Short.

@deskFinOpenFolder.description: Button next to a file name: open the folder that holds the file in the system's file manager.

@deskFinFolderNotOpened.description: Toast title when the file manager could not be opened; the folder path follows as text.

@deskFinWrongType.description: Title of the error notice on the Finalize page: the chosen file is not a response file.

deskFinWrongTypeText: The file is not a response file. Choose the file the recipient sent back.

@deskFinUnreadable.description: Title of the error notice on the Finalize page: the chosen file could not be read.

deskFinUnreadableText: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or still being copied.

@deskFinFailed.description: Title of the error notice on the Finalize page: the wallet could not finalize the file.

deskFinFailedText: The wallet could not finalize this file. It may belong to another transaction or be finalized already.

@deskFinNotPosted.description: Title of the error notice on the Finalize page: the node did not accept the finalized transaction.

deskFinNotPostedText: The transaction was finalized but the node did not accept it. Check the node, then try again.

@deskFinPickTitle.description: Title of the system file dialog that picks the recipient's response file.

@deskFinPosted.description: Toast and result title after the response file was finalized and posted.

deskFinNoticeTitle: For a transaction created as a file

@deskFinNoticeTitle.description: Title of the info notice at the top of the Finalize page.

deskFinNoticeText: Use the response file the recipient sent back.

@deskFinNoticeText.description: Text of the info notice at the top of the Finalize page.

@deskFinTryAgain.description: Button in the "Not posted" notice on Finalize: choose the file again.

deskFinPostedText: The payment was finalized and sent to the network. Follow it in Activity.

@deskFinPostedText.description: Text of the result card after finalizing.

@deskFinAnother.description: Button on the result card after finalizing.

@deskFinViewActivity.description: Button on the result cards of Finalize and Sign a transaction file: opens the payment in Activity.

@deskFinBusy.description: Shown next to a spinner while the wallet finalizes and posts the transaction.

@deskFinChoose.description: Title of the drop zone on Finalize.

deskFinChooseText: The wallet completes the transaction and posts it to the network.

@deskFinChooseText.description: Text of the drop zone on Finalize.

@deskFinChooseFile.description: Button in the drop zones of Finalize and Sign a transaction file: opens the system file dialog.

@deskImpWrongType.description: Title of the error notice on the Sign a transaction file page: the chosen file is not a transaction file.

deskImpWrongTypeText: The file is not a transaction file. Choose the .slate or .tx file the sender gave.
deskImpWrongTypePasted: The pasted text is not a transaction. Paste the whole text the sender gave, or choose their file.

@deskImpWrongTypePasted.description: Text of that notice when the text pasted into Send (not a file) is not a transaction.

@deskImpUnreadable.description: Title of the error notice on the Sign a transaction file page: the file could not be read.

deskImpUnreadableText: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or still being copied.

@deskImpNoPlace.description: Title of the error notice: no place was chosen to save the response file.

deskImpNoPlaceText: No place was chosen for the response file, so nothing was signed.

@deskImpFailed.description: Title of the error notice: the wallet could not sign the file.

deskImpFailedText: The wallet could not sign this file. It may be for another wallet or already used.
deskImpFailedDetail: The wallet could not sign this file. It may be for another wallet or already used. {detail}.

@deskImpFailedDetail.description: Text of that notice when the wallet gave its own reason. {detail} is that reason, a short sentence without its final full stop.

@deskImpPickTitle.description: Title of the system file dialog that picks the sender's transaction file.

@deskImpTitle.description: Page title of Sign a transaction file.

@deskImpNoticeTitle.description: Title of the info notice at the top of the Sign a transaction file page.

deskImpNoticeText: Send the response file back to the sender over the same channel they used.

@deskImpNoticeText.description: Text of the info notice at the top of the page.

@deskImpSaved.description: Title of the result card after the response file was saved.

deskImpSavedText: Send the response file back to the sender. The EPIC arrives once the sender finalizes it.

@deskImpSavedText.description: Text of the result card after signing.

@deskImpAmount.description: Label before the amount on the result card. Ends with a space.

@deskImpAnother.description: Button on the result card after signing.

@deskImpBusy.description: Shown next to a spinner while the wallet signs the file.

@deskImpChoose.description: Title of the drop zone on Sign a transaction file.

deskImpChooseText: The wallet signs it and saves a response for the sender.

@deskImpOpenAnother.description: Import page, after a request file was paid and its answer saved: start over with another file. Not "sign": paying a request spent money.
